limitations: Requires a full-dimensional compact convex body and independent uniform point sampling.
The geometric distance is the gauge of the full difference body, not Euclidean distance.
No nonconvex extension or quantitative stability rate is established.
An equivalent historical probabilistic or radial-mean-body formulation cannot be ruled out without further independent priority investigation.
scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes the stated all-dimensional inequality and equality condition using documented classical Brunn–Minkowski and Rogers–Shephard results. Exact and simulated diagnostics are ancillary and are not asserted to certify the infinite theorem. Publication priority and independent verification remain open.
title: A sharp beta stochastic bound for difference-body distances
